name: Akshay Nayak

journey: Graduated in 2021 with B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering from Reva University
Joined Altrodav in 2025 as full-time AIML Developer

growth_areas: Deepening ML fundamentals and model evaluation to make stronger model selection decisions
Gaining broader production engineering experience in observability, performance, and scalability
Improving technical communication, documentation, and explaining architectural trade-offs

career_goals.five_year_vision: Lead technical direction and architecture for high-impact AI products, bridging cutting-edge ML research with robust, scalable production engineering, and mentoring engineers.
career_goals.professional_focus: Mastering agentic workflows, production retrieval evaluation, and high-performance inference while designing dependable, cost-effective architectures that solve real-world problems.

coworker_misconception: People sometimes assume that because I work heavily across backend APIs and model pipelines, I focus only on code. In reality, I care deeply about product usability, structured evaluation, and keeping team interfaces transparent and reliable.
pushing_limits: I push my boundaries by clarifying core outcomes, taking on unfamiliar or high-risk challenges first, testing failure modes early, and iterating rapidly on feedback.

projects.name: MeetMux
projects.description: AI-powered facial verification for an Android application.
projects.details: Implemented real-time face detection, facial embedding generation, selfie-based identity verification, and liveness checks to prevent fake accounts and spoofing on mobile.

projects.details: Designed and developed an automated evaluation pipeline assessing candidate assignments to generate structured scores, strengths, weaknesses, and improvement suggestions, reducing evaluation turnaround time to approximately 1–2 minutes.

projects.name: PlaceMux Support & Knowledge Chat Assistant
